say:1:1611316001:1.text: Magister, good timing. It appeared out of nowhere, but hasn't attacked anyone...
say:1:1611316001:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，您来了就太好了。这只魔物出现得很突然，但不知...
say:1:1611316001:1.male: Magister, good timing. It appeared out of nowhere, but hasn't attacked anyone...
say:1:1611316001:1.female: Magister, good timing. It appeared out of nowhere, but hasn't attacked anyone...

say:2:1611316002:1.text: I thought about attacking it, but we can't afford to risk destroying any of the art.
say:2:1611316002:1.source_cn: 其实我刚考虑过该如何攻击它，但……您看到了，这里是画廊...
say:2:1611316002:1.male: I thought about attacking it, but we can't afford to risk destroying any of the art.
say:2:1611316002:1.female: I thought about attacking it, but we can't afford to risk destroying any of the art.

say:3:1611316003:1.text: Silven and I could try containment spells, but if it goes berserk, everything here is at risk.
say:3:1611316003:1.source_cn: 虽然我们可以使用防护魔法，可一旦开始战斗，魔物有很大概...
say:3:1611316003:1.male: Silven and I could try containment spells, but if it goes berserk, everything here is at risk.
say:3:1611316003:1.female: Silven and I could try containment spells, but if it goes berserk, everything here is at risk.

say:5:1611316004:1.text: The Hypofiend wanders slowly. You suspect this is the one Durella released from your Memory Star.
say:5:1611316004:1.source_cn: 你看着那只慢吞吞的魔物，你高度怀疑，它原本应该老老实实...
say:5:1611316004:1.male: The Hypofiend wanders slowly. You suspect this is the one Durella released from your Memory Star.
say:5:1611316004:1.female: The Hypofiend wanders slowly. You suspect this is the one Durella released from your Memory Star.

say:6:1611316005:1.text: It looks overwhelmed, as if tasting freedom after years of confinement.
say:6:1611316005:1.source_cn: 魔物的反应很慢，被禁闭了这么多年，它似乎一时半会还没有...
say:6:1611316005:1.male: It looks overwhelmed, as if tasting freedom after years of confinement.
say:6:1611316005:1.female: It looks overwhelmed, as if tasting freedom after years of confinement.

say:7:1611316006:1.text: As you consider your next move, hurried footsteps approach.
say:7:1611316006:1.source_cn: 你正准备上前制服它，身后却突然传来了一阵嘈杂的声音。
say:7:1611316006:1.male: As you consider your next move, hurried footsteps approach.
say:7:1611316006:1.female: As you consider your next move, hurried footsteps approach.

say:9:1611316007:0.text: Make way for the Grand Mentor!
say:9:1611316007:0.source_cn: 让让，快让让，大导师来了！

say:10:1611316008:0.text: The Grand Mentor will save us!
say:10:1611316008:0.source_cn: 大导师听说这里有魔物出现，专程来制服它！

cinematic_dialogue:14:1611317002:.text: So the Grand Mentor is a mage too?

cinematic_dialogue:14:1611317004:.text: Stay calm, and no harm will come.
cinematic_dialogue:14:1611317004:.source_cn: 你只要听话，就没有生命危险

cinematic_dialogue:14:1611317005:.text: This is winning—for both of us.

say:16:1611318001:0.text: Everyone, settle down. Listen carefully, and I promise you'll stay safe. Cooperation... that's the real key here.
say:16:1611318001:0.source_cn: 虽然你是魔物，但我知道你能听懂我的话，这是来自心灵层面...

say:17:1611318002:1.text: Hypofiend, yes, I can tell you understand me. You're not angry, are you? Just... lonely. Misunderstood.
say:17:1611318002:1.source_cn: 停下吧，大家伙，不要愤怒，不要攻击。你的身体在颤抖——...

say:18:1611318003:1.text: You don't seek destruction. You seek to be seen. To be respected. These young ones aren't here to judge you. They're simply watching... waiting to see who you'll choose to be.
say:18:1611318003:1.source_cn: 真正的力量不是毁灭，而是“被看见”。你看我旁边这些年轻...

say:19:1611318004:1.text: Give me your anger. Your pain. I won't seal you away or strike you down like others would. I'll show the world what you can become. And <style="highlight">that's how everyone wins</style>.
say:19:1611318004:1.source_cn: 来，把你的痛苦交给我。我不封印你，也不毁灭你，我会让大...

say:20:1611318005:1.text: Something stirs in your mind—but before you can grasp it, Esten continues.
say:20:1611318005:1.source_cn: 不知为何，你的脑海中瞬间闪过了一丝奇异的感受，但尚未等...
say:20:1611318005:1.male: Something stirs in your mind—but before you can grasp it, Esten continues.
say:20:1611318005:1.female: Something stirs in your mind—but before you can grasp it, Esten continues.

say:21:1611318006:1.text: Yes, exactly. Trust me completely. Lay down your anger—it's poisonous. Let it go.
say:21:1611318006:1.source_cn: 全心全意地信任我、跟随我吧，大家伙。来，按照我说的做—...

say:22:1611318007:1.text: The Hypofiend growls... then slowly lowers its head. The students gasp.
say:22:1611318007:1.source_cn: 那只魔物低吼了一声，乖乖地低下头，垂下双臂。周围的学生...
say:22:1611318007:1.male: The Hypofiend growls... then slowly lowers its head. The students gasp.
say:22:1611318007:1.female: The Hypofiend growls... then slowly lowers its head. The students gasp.

say:23:1611318008:0.text: That's right. Treat others kindly, and they'll return the same. If you understand, nod.
say:23:1611318008:0.source_cn: 没错，温良。他人待你会像你待他人。明白吗？明白的话就点...

say:24:1611318009:1.source_cn: 魔物很配合地点了点头。

say:25:1611318010:1.text: Tell me—will you raise violence again?
say:25:1611318010:1.source_cn: 现在你已经找到了内心的平静。用你的方式告诉我，以后还会...

say:26:1611318011:1.text: After a long pause, the Hypofiend shakes its head.
say:26:1611318011:1.source_cn: 魔物呆愣了一下，摇了摇头。
say:26:1611318011:1.male: After a long pause, the Hypofiend shakes its head.
say:26:1611318011:1.female: After a long pause, the Hypofiend shakes its head.

say:27:1611318012:1.text: Remember this peace. Remember that we are not your enemy—and you are not ours.
say:27:1611318012:1.source_cn: 很好，就是这样！记住你现在内心的感受，让安宁喜乐的情绪...

say:28:1611318013:1.text: The Hypofiend scratches its head. The fearsome creature now seems almost harmless. Esten pats it gently, then turns to the crowd.
say:28:1611318013:1.source_cn: 魔物挠了挠头，在旁观者的眼中，它居然变得有些憨傻了起来...
say:28:1611318013:1.male: The Hypofiend scratches its head. The fearsome creature now seems almost harmless. Esten pats it gently, then turns to the crowd.
say:28:1611318013:1.female: The Hypofiend scratches its head. The fearsome creature now seems almost harmless. Esten pats it gently, then turns to the crowd.

say:29:1611318014:0.text: As you've just seen, Hypofiends are lost souls—not monsters. When we understand instead of reject, conflict fades. Compassion turns even the fiercest into something gentle.
say:29:1611318014:0.source_cn: 看到了吗？所谓“魔物”，不过是被悲伤困住的灵魂。当你用...

say:30:1611318015:0.text: Remember this, my young friends. The strength of the soul surpasses even the greatest magic.
say:30:1611318015:0.source_cn: 记住了，我的朋友们：心灵的力量，有时比魔法更锋利。

say:32:1611318016:0.source_cn: 感谢您的教导，尊敬的大导师。

say:33:1611318017:0.text: Come. Let's take our friend somewhere safe.
say:33:1611318017:0.source_cn: 走吧，我们带着这个大家伙离开这里。

say:35:1611318018:1.text: Esten leads the Hypofiend out of the gallery. The students remain behind, stunned and whispering.
say:35:1611318018:1.source_cn: 埃斯特大导师带着魔物，在学生们惊讶纷纷的议论声中，被信...
say:35:1611318018:1.male: Esten leads the Hypofiend out of the gallery. The students remain behind, stunned and whispering.
say:35:1611318018:1.female: Esten leads the Hypofiend out of the gallery. The students remain behind, stunned and whispering.

say:36:1611318019:0.text: Silven is speechless. You glance at Solise—her raised eyebrow mirrors your disbelief.
say:36:1611318019:0.source_cn: 休惊讶地睁大了眼睛，你和娑丽丝对视一眼，都皱起了眉头，...
say:36:1611318019:0.male: Silven is speechless. You glance at Solise—her raised eyebrow mirrors your disbelief.
say:36:1611318019:0.female: Silven is speechless. You glance at Solise—her raised eyebrow mirrors your disbelief.

say:37:1611318020:0.text: Taming a Hypofiend... without spells. Was it magic? Something else entirely? How did this Grand Mentor do it?
say:37:1611318020:0.source_cn: 驯服魔物——这是某种特殊魔法，还是什么别的手段？这个大...
say:37:1611318020:0.male: Taming a Hypofiend... without spells. Was it magic? Something else entirely? How did this Grand Mentor do it?
say:37:1611318020:0.female: Taming a Hypofiend... without spells. Was it magic? Something else entirely? How did this Grand Mentor do it?

narration:39:16011282:0.text: The Grand Mentor appears and casts a spell to subdue the Hypofiend, forcing it to obey his commands.
narration:39:16011282:0.source_cn: 大导师出现，施法降服了魔物，让它听从自己的指令。
